name: 17938 · Hegins, PA
findings: ZIP 17938 (Hegins) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17938 (Hegins) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17938 (Hegins) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).
